messages:
elaine: Observing a p99 decode tail increase (~10%) on host-proxy after yesterday's kernel-selector flip. Canary repro.
mohit: I repro locally. Perf flame shows parse_frame and tokenize_inline at the top; a lot of small syscalls from the stream framer.
ryan: paste the flame snippet?
elaine:
```
  28.9% parse_frame
  19.3% tokenize_inline
  11.8% syscall:read
   8.7% memmove
   6.5% kernel_selector::choose
```
mohit: kernel_selector log: selected matmul_v2_fallback for many short seqs (seq<=16). That fallback copies input to aligned buffers, extra memmove.
sam: kvcache hitrate steady (~81%). Looks host-side. Likely smallwrite patterns (http2/gRPC) causing many tiny frames and noisy seq distribution.
perf-bot: ALERT host-proxy p99 +0.085s since 2026-03-21T22:40Z. Correlated with kernel-selector toggle.
ryan: Quick mitigations to try on canary:
- bump smallwrite batching timeout 3ms->6ms
- enable ingress writev coalesce
- prefer matmul_v1 for seq<32 in selector priority
mohit: microbench: aggressive low-latency flush leads to batch sizes 1-2 and 8-12% slower overall.
sam: enabling writev coalesce reduced syscall rate ~38% and sys CPU ~11% in short run.
elaine: pushing a canary hotfix with selector tweak + coalesce + timeout bump. Deployed 2026-03-22T09:12Z. Initial telemetry: p99 down ~6%, sys CPU down ~17% on canary. Watching for regressions for bursty clients.
ryan: follow-ups: add selector unit tests for seq buckets, add perf harness for http2 smallwrites, run kvcache stress to validate no side-effect.
mohit: opening PR with benchmarks, tagging @sam for writev review.
elaine: thanks all — will monitor canary for 24h then promote if stable. :thumbsup:
